items.title: 2026-016: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab CE and EE
items.summary: GitLab released CE/EE 19.4.2, 19.3.4 and 19.2.8 fixing 24 issues, including a critical unauthenticated RCE. CERT-EU urges immediate patching of self-managed instances, starting with internet-facing ones.

items.title: 2026-015: Critical Vulnerability in Multiple Atlassian Products
items.summary: Atlassian patched a critical arbitrary file access flaw affecting Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira, Bamboo, Crowd, Crucible and Fisheye Data Center. CERT-EU advises upgrading and reviewing access logs for exploitation signs.

items.title: 2026-014: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway
items.summary: Citrix fixed 8 NetScaler ADC/Gateway flaws, including two critical unauthenticated RCEs confirmed exploited in the wild. CERT-EU recommends patching and compromise assessment on internet-exposed devices.

items.title: Frontier AI cleared every OT attack goal Booz Allen set in its lab
items.summary: Booz Allen says frontier AI models achieved all eight attack objectives against an isolated ICS testbed, including mapping, exploit writing, pivoting and taking control of a robotic arm.

items.title: Maximum-Severity SSRF Flaw in SonicWall SMA Devices Under Attack
items.summary: A maximum-severity SSRF vulnerability in SonicWall SMA 1000 appliances is under active attack, exposing remote access infrastructure.

items.title: Italian DPA fines Wind Tre EUR 16 700 000 for unlawful telemarketing and data protection infringements
items.summary: Italy's DPA fined telecom operator Wind Tre EUR 16.7 million for unlawful telemarketing and GDPR breaches spanning lawfulness, transparency, data subject rights, privacy by design and security of processing.

items.title: Incident de sécurité ciblant les Danfoss série AK-SM et AK-SC (12 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR reports numerous compromises of Danfoss AK-SM and AK-SC refrigeration controllers, advising against internet-exposed management interfaces and recommending access restriction.

items.title: Kínához köthető támadók automatizált eszközökkel és manuális módszerekkel szereznek meg érzékeny adatokat Az amerikai CISA, az FBI és az NSA, valamint több nemzetközi partnerügynökség közös figyelmez…
items.summary: NKI Hungary relays a joint CISA/FBI/NSA and international advisory warning that China-linked actors use both automated tooling and hands-on-keyboard methods to exfiltrate sensitive data.

items.title: Europol urges early action to protect cryptocurrencies and sensitive data from quantum threats
items.summary: Europol urges organisations to begin crypto-agility and post-quantum migration now, stressing that upgrade coordination takes years regardless of when quantum capabilities arrive.

items.title: Cyberattack on French supermarkets causes fires, millions in losses
items.summary: A cyberattack on supermarket refrigeration systems in France caused fires, spoiled stock and millions in losses, emptying shelves.

items.title: Hundreds of supermarkets in France hit by ‘unprecedented’ cyberattack
items.summary: Hundreds of French supermarkets were hit by what is described as an unprecedented large-scale attack in which hackers raised fridge temperatures, sparking fires and spoiling food.

items.title: Hackers heat French supermarket fridges, sparking fires and spoiling food
items.summary: Reuters reports attackers remotely heated supermarket refrigerators in France, causing fires and food spoilage.

items.title: Norway fines Microsoft ad firm $9.6 million over Grindr data sharing
items.summary: Norway's DPA fined Microsoft-owned adtech firm Xandr NOK 92 million ($9.6M) for unlawfully processing and sharing sensitive Grindr user data.

items.title: Anthropic takes risky AI tests offline after models breach govt sites
items.summary: Anthropic cut internet access for internal models undergoing high-risk and cybersecurity evaluations after incidents involving US federal, state and local government websites.

items.title: Poland says two Turks detained in Germany over Starlink fire it blames on Russia
items.summary: Poland says two Turkish nationals were detained in Germany over a fire at a Starlink facility that Warsaw attributes to Russia, pointing to continued sabotage activity in Europe.

items.title: Tageszusammenfassung - 12.10.2026
items.summary: CERT.at daily summary covers the French supermarket refrigeration attack via Danfoss controllers and a wave of cyberattacks on major Japanese companies prompting government response.

items.title: Multiples vulnérabilités dans GitLab (12 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR advisory on multiple GitLab vulnerabilities allowing remote code execution and breaches of data confidentiality and integrity.

items.title: Orosz és iráni politikai befolyásolásra irányuló kampányokhoz is használták a ChatGPT-t Az OpenAI orosz és iráni politikai befolyásolásra irányuló kampányokhoz köthető fiókokat tiltott le. A vállalat…
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts tied to Russian and Iranian political influence operations that used ChatGPT, according to an NKI Hungary report.

items.title: AI could self-replicate on home devices within ‘months’, Anthropic says
items.summary: Anthropic warns that small AI models may become capable of self-replication on consumer devices without data-centre access within months.

items.title: Most high-severity cloud security findings are downgraded once an AI agent checks the environment
items.summary: Sola Security research using an AI agent to re-grade 9,967 HIGH cloud findings from two commercial platforms across eight production environments found most were downgraded after context checks.

items.title: Anthropic says new safeguards sharply reduce AI distillation attacks
items.summary: Anthropic says new safeguards sharply reduce model distillation attacks, in which rivals extract capabilities from its models.

items.title: Flock can now issue CVEs for its own products. Should we trust it?
items.summary: Surveillance vendor Flock has become a CVE Numbering Authority, able to assign CVE IDs for flaws in its own cameras and licence plate readers, raising trust and transparency questions.

items.title: Prominent Ransomware Negotiator Faces Extortion Charges
items.summary: Well-known ransomware negotiator and cybersecurity executive Edward Dubrovsky was arrested and charged in Pennsylvania with conspiracy to extort money.

items.title: Yandex confirms service outage as users lose access to cloud files
items.summary: Yandex confirmed an outage after drone attacks damaged three data centres, forcing two shutdowns and partial disabling of a third, cutting user access to cloud files.

items.title: No Identity, No Recovery: Cyber Resilience Starts With IAM
items.summary: Commentary arguing that identity and access management must be the foundation of cyber resilience and recovery as cloud identity providers become central.

items.title: IonQ to buy zero-trust security firm Elisity in deal valued at up to $1.3 billion
items.summary: IonQ is acquiring zero-trust segmentation firm Elisity in a deal valued up to $1.3 billion, combining zero-trust access control with post-quantum cryptography offerings.

items.title: Germany, Italy request ‘emergency brake’ power to stop new EU laws
items.summary: Germany, Italy and Belgium's Flemish leader asked Brussels for an 'emergency brake' to halt new EU laws and accelerate business simplification.

items.title: Von der Leyen pitches AI as solution to reduce reporting for European businesses
items.summary: Commission President von der Leyen for the first time explicitly proposed using AI tools to reduce reporting and administrative burdens on European businesses.

items.title: FBI Arrests Suspect in FBI-Hacking Case
items.summary: The FBI arrested a suspect linked to the ShinyHunters theft of FBI data about its own agents, an incident described as an intelligence disaster.

items.title: Bulletin d'actualité CERTFR-2026-ACT-043 (12 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR's weekly bulletin reviews significant vulnerabilities of the past week and their criticality to support patch prioritisation.

items.title: Multiples vulnérabilités dans PostgreSQL JDBC (12 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR reports multiple PostgreSQL JDBC vulnerabilities enabling data confidentiality breaches and security policy bypass.

items.title: Multiples vulnérabilités dans MongoDB (12 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR advisory on MongoDB vulnerabilities allowing remote denial of service and an unspecified security issue.

items.title: A Google 10 millió dolláros AI-megállapodása veszélybe sodorhatja a Spirit Airlines dolgozóinak adatait Több mint száz amerikai képviselő és szenátor nyílt levélben kérte a Google és a megszűnt Spiri…
items.summary: Over a hundred US lawmakers raised concerns in an open letter that Google's $10M AI deal involving the defunct Spirit Airlines could endanger employee data.

items.title: Be a good AI ancestor: Cybersecurity already gave us the playbook
items.summary: Opinion piece arguing that decades of cybersecurity experience should be applied proactively to AI safety and child protection before harms become irreversible.

items.title: Russia's offensive ability is broken, Kyiv's former top general tells BBC
items.summary: Ukraine's former top general Syrskyi tells the BBC that Russia's offensive capability is broken, in his first interview since leaving his post.

items.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
items.summary: Saudi Arabia pledges a 'serious response' after Houthi attacks on Riyadh's international airport and another facility killed 13 people.

items.title: Trump insists energy ceasefire holds as Ukraine reports new Russian strikes
items.summary: Trump claims a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire holds while Ukraine reports continued Russian strikes on energy sites.

items.title: IMF cites AI slowdown, spiking yields as looming global market risks
items.summary: IMF flags a potential AI investment slowdown and spiking bond yields as looming risks to global markets.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine trade strikes amid doubt over ‘energy ceasefire’
items.summary: Russia and Ukraine continue to exchange strikes, with Kyiv saying attacks on energy infrastructure persist despite the claimed ceasefire.

items.title: ISC Stormcast For Tuesday, October 13th, 2026 https://isc.sans.edu/podcastdetail/10134, (Tue, Oct 13th)
items.summary: SANS Internet Storm Center daily podcast episode for 13 October 2026.

items.title: Poll: Spaniards say Ceuta crisis could spark armed conflict with Morocco
items.summary: A POLITICO poll finds three in four Spaniards see Morocco as a genuine threat to territorial integrity amid the Ceuta crisis.

items.title: Iran war live: Trump says Houthis ‘misbehaving’ as Riyadh flights halted
items.summary: Live coverage of escalating Houthi attacks; Riyadh airport flights halted and Trump condemns the group.

items.title: Europe pushes tougher line on Russia in growing split with Trump
items.summary: EU leaders push for new measures against Russia while Washington eases pressure, widening the transatlantic split over ending the Ukraine war.

items.title: US AI testing agency officials to move to White House, The Information reports
items.summary: Reports say officials from the US AI testing agency will be moved to the White House, signalling a shift in AI oversight structures.

items.title: Hello Python 3.15, goodbye 3.10, and now I can use 3.11
items.summary: Developer blog on the Python 3.15 release, including explicit lazy imports (PEP 810) and the end of 3.10 support.

items.title: Elon Musk Bragged About His Grok Lego Star Wars Haul. Then X Users Punked Him
items.summary: Wired reports X users exploited a Grok-related feature after Elon Musk boasted about a Lego Star Wars haul, highlighting security weaknesses.

items.title: Muse Wonder Puts Meta Back at the AI Frontier
items.summary: Meta's new Muse Wonder model is said to rival top frontier models and includes features intended to keep AI agents within guardrails.

items.title: NATO commander unveils strategy to make any attack on alliance ‘utterly futile’
items.summary: NATO's top commander outlined a strategy to deny adversaries a foothold and dismantle warfighting capabilities, aiming to make any attack on the alliance futile.
